rust_crates_dependencies.note: harpe Cargo.toml declares zero dependencies. kibisis and argus-ledger declare minimal focused dependencies (rusqlite, zeroize, ed25519-dalek, sha2).

network_code.note: No socket, HTTP, or network code in any of the three library crates (verified by source tree audit).

rust_unit_tests.note: harpe (4), kibisis (11), argus-ledger (23); all tests pass under rustc 1.97.1.

python_tests.note: harpe (42), kibisis (58), argus-ledger (35); all tests pass under pytest.

kibisis_cipher.note: Python kibisis uses SQLCipher full-page database encryption with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600,000 iterations). Rust kibisis provides in-memory vault and lease coordinator.

argus_structure.value: Linear SHA-256 hash chain with optional Ed25519 signed checkpoints
argus_structure.note: Argus uses a strictly linear SHA-256 hash chain where each event covers sequence, id, timestamp, type, actor, prev_hash, and payload.

harpe_algorithm.note: Pinned items first, then remaining items in priority order while budget remains. Deterministic; not an optimal 0/1 knapsack packing.

retired.claim: Higher token-reduction and lower per-turn time (84.77% / 24.3 µs) plus dollar savings
retired.why: The repository's committed report (step1_knapsack_cost_curve.json) proves 78.28% and 46.9 µs/turn at ca3dff7. Dollar figures depend on assumed provider pricing and are omitted from headline claims.

retired.claim: Argus instant tamper detection in tens of microseconds
retired.why: The 42 µs figure was an early abort near genesis. Reaching an edit at sequence 500,000 in a 1M event ledger takes 185.35 ms.
Argus is a linear SHA-256 hash chain. Described as that accurately across all surfaces.
Harpe uses deterministic priority-ordered greedy selection, not an exact 0/1 integer programming solver.

retired.claim: Zero-allocation steady state; zero garbage collection
retired.why: Harpe allocates context items. Absence of garbage collection is an inherent Rust property, not a library feature.

retired.claim: CMMC Level 2, NIST SP 800-53, or ATO ready
retired.why: No independent security or compliance assessment has been completed. The libraries are designed for local and disconnected use.
PGP key was not published on keys.openpgp.org. Removed until key publication.
